title: Enterprise Connectivity: negotiated pricing permission
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following negotiated pricing permission for each named contract tier. Whether an approved signed unit-rate amendment overrides the standard primary rate; boolean.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | negotiated pricing permission | permitted |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | negotiated pricing permission | permitted |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | negotiated pricing permission | permitted |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | negotiated pricing permission | permitted |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | negotiated pricing permission | permitted |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | negotiated pricing permission | permitted |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the negotiated pricing permission is permitted.
